id_and_class.summary: Jinesh K. Sebastian models the brain as a multi-layered feedback control system that predicts future states of a world model and corrects them against sensory data, driven by minimizing a scalar he calls ‘qualia potential’. Consciousness is an emergent process that observes this world model, feels changes in qualia potential, and can identify with a self-model inside it, much like the Seer (Puruṣa) of Sāṅkhya philosophy, except that it is not eternal.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Observer of a Predictive World Model

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is an emergent process that observes the brain’s predictive world model, experiences variations in qualia potential, and becomes the locus of experience when it couples with the self-model.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Consciousness arises from neurological processes in the predictive loop. Sebastian borrows the Sāṅkhya picture of a witnessing Seer but makes it a product of the brain rather than an eternal principle.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Weak emergence (from the dynamics of a hierarchical predictive control loop)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Every entity in the world model, including the self-model, is an object. Subjective perception arises when consciousness embodies the self-model; if that coupling weakens, consciousness can experience the world model without embodiment, which Sebastian uses to explain out-of-body experiences.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Felt quality tracks qualia potential, a latent scalar that drives motivation and perception and that Sebastian compares to the three gunas (sattva, rajas, tamas) of Sāṅkhya.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Neural oscillatory centers (delta, beta, gamma, alpha, theta), a learned world model with priors, a self-model as one object within it, and the qualia potential quantity.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through computational modeling grounded in predictive neuroscience and brain-rhythm data, checked against reported phenomena such as illusions, psychedelic visuals and meditative states.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A closed loop: a delta center generates predictions, a beta center splits them by sense, parallel gamma centers compute modality-specific errors, alpha centers integrate errors over short windows, and a theta center fuses them across senses before returning the correction to delta.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal, Self-awareness (self-model embodiment), Perception, Motivation, Altered states
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Qualia-potential minimization within a delayed error-integration loop. Surprise is reduced in two stages: sensory grounding resolves world-model mismatches, then qualia potential is optimized to guide future predictions and action.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness is an ongoing process. The world model updates only after alpha-band integration, and the length of that integration window sets how long percepts persist; lengthening it causes successive updates to overlap.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Distributed across a hierarchy of brain centers aligned with oscillatory bands, from delta at the apex to parallel gamma centers for each sense.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: The loop serves control: it keeps the world model calibrated to the senses and selects actions. Qualia potential supplies motivation, sustained goal pursuit and homeostatic drive.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: The theta center combines parallel alpha outputs over several alpha cycles with modality-dependent weights and thresholds, yielding coherent multisensory perception and letting one sense stand in for a missing one.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Top-down priors flow as delta and beta signals; bottom-up prediction errors appear as gamma activity, are integrated as alpha and theta activity, and return to update the world model.
core_claims_and_evidence: The alpha integration window explains persistence of vision, and its lengthening explains motion trails and frame-like perception after psychedelics.
Weighted multisensory fusion at the theta center accounts for the rubber hand illusion.
Resonant modes in the predictive loop produce geometric patterns, akin to Chladni figures, reported in deep meditation and psychedelic states.
Separating sensory grounding from qualia-potential optimization resolves the dark-room problem facing pure surprise minimization.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Computational and theoretical modeling, drawing on predictive neuroscience, brain-rhythm research and Sāṅkhya philosophy

empirics_and_critiques.known_empirical_interventions_or_tests: Sebastian points to persistence of vision, the rubber hand illusion, psychedelic visual effects, and reports of discrete-frame perception in acquired savant syndrome (such as Jason Padgett) as phenomena the model explains.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: The mapping of specific computational roles onto oscillatory bands, and the physical nature of qualia potential, are proposed rather than demonstrated. Why observing a world model should be experienced at all is left to the analogy with the Sāṅkhya Seer.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Fits within a physicalist, predictive-processing framework. Borrowing the dualist Sāṅkhya vocabulary of Seer and gunas while making consciousness emergent and non-eternal creates an interpretive tension the theory must keep straight.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Sebastian frames the model as a control architecture shared by minds and robots, so a machine built on the same predictive loop could in principle support consciousness.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since consciousness here emerges from neurological processes and is explicitly not eternal, it ends with the brain.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Consciousness serves prediction, control and motivation within the organism; the view assigns it no cosmic purpose.

virtual_immortality.rationale: If the predictive loop and its qualia-potential dynamics were reproduced in another substrate, the same process could follow.
